pattern.crimePattern: a business partner who skimmed the studio's gold kills her co-founder when she finds out, and frames the workshop manager she had already blamed
pattern.notes: Fictional studio, building and hotel group. Teaches PLANTED: the apron in the fired man's locker. The guard who wrote the false sign-in entry was paid and didn't know why (an unknowing helper, not an accomplice). Spine background: Advocate Kiprop's retainer is paid through Till 880 214 (t_mvua).

ob.text: A building manager in Westlands reports a jewellery designer found dead in her third-floor workshop: Wakesho Mghanga (34), co-founder of Shah & Mghanga Studio. Within the hour, staff name a former employee.

facts.text: Wakesho Mghanga was found dead in her third-floor workshop in Westlands on Friday morning.
Two blows to Wakesho's head from a narrow, tapered steel object.
A steel ring mandrel lies on the floor, wiped. The hammers hang clean on their pegs.
The staff: "It's Kevin. He was angry when she fired him." Kevin Otieno was fired two weeks ago for "missing gold".
In Kevin's old locker, opened with the master key: his workshop apron, bloodstained down the front.
The apron's blood is a broad wiped smear filling the weave evenly. No droplets, no spatter.
Sign-in book: "K. Otieno — 21:05 — collect tools", in the guard's handwriting, with no visitor signature.
Lift camera: Kevin up at 18:31, down at 19:02 with a box. Nobody in the lift after 19:40.
Building manager: the stairs door to the lobby is alarmed after 20:00; it was never opened from the lobby side, only from the basement by a card holder.

Zawadi left at 18:00 (lift camera) for her evening class, then went home with her flatmates.

The safe is locked; stock and cash are all there.

reconstruction.text: For a year Priya records short weights for her own batches and sells the difference. When the losses show, she points Wakesho at Kevin, who handles the scale, and Wakesho fires him.

On Wednesday Wakesho rechecks the ledger herself: every short weight is in Priya's batches. A forwarded email shows Priya taking the hotel client and the designs. On Thursday at five Wakesho says she'll see a lawyer on Friday.
At 21:12 Priya drives into the basement, walks up the stairs, and finds Wakesho working late. They argue at the bench. Priya strikes her twice with a steel ring mandrel.

She wipes Wakesho's blood onto Kevin's old apron and locks it in his locker with her master key. At 22:01 she pays Hezron KSh 5,000 to write "K. Otieno — 21:05 — collect tools". She drives out at 22:04.

afterVerdict.beat: Kevin gets a letter from the studio's new administrator: his name cleared, his final dues paid again with an apology. Zawadi takes over Wakesho's bench.

ui.beatNotes: Suspected planted. Long-pressing an evidence card offers "mark as suspected planted": the card gets a red edge and moves to its own corner of the board. Planted items can't be used to press a suspect until the player either proves or clears them, so the game rewards checking before accusing.
